item.title: Women are protesting around Poland for free access to legal abortions
item.description: Women are protesting around Poland for access to free and legal abortion services. Poland's abortion laws are among the most restrictive in Europe.

item.title: A city in South Korea seeks new ways to free a huge gray shark after it slips back into canal
item.description: A city in South Korea is again trying to free a huge dusky shark from a narrow canal. Workers in Busan had herded the shark, nicknamed Bukangi, out of the canal on Wednesday after weeks of trial and error, only for it to swim back in hours later.

item.title: A second female lawmaker in Australia is threatened days after alleged car attack
item.description: A man has been charged with threatening an Australian lawmaker’s staff with nunchucks days after another legislator was critically injured when a man repeatedly hit her with a car.
